paraphrase: Inertial rival (unattributed): some body is being moved in a respect of uniform rectilinear motion while nothing moves it in that respect. Newton's first law (STMT-NEWTON-LEX-I-CHANGE-OF-STATE-ONLY-BY-IMPRESSED-FORCE) motivates it but does not state it: the rival adds that some moving body is free of impressed force and that a state of uniform motion is a being moved.
